extDescription.message: Save the page you are reading, a link or a selection to Deepn, then read its summary and chat with it.

saveFailed.message: This page could not be saved.

notSavable.message: This page cannot be saved: it is not a web address.

pairTitle.message: Link the extension to your account

pairOneClick.message: Open Deepn on the web, go to My account › Browser extension, and click “Link this extension”.

pairRescue.message: Or type the code shown there, with your account email:

pairFailed.message: This code does not work. Ask for a new one if it has expired.

pairExpired.message: The link with your account has expired. Link the extension again.

selectionFailed.message: The selection could not be saved.

signOutFailed.message: Could not sign out. Check your connection and try again.

pairFirefox.message: Open Deepn on the web, go to My account › Browser extension, and click “Show a code”.

pairFirefoxCode.message: Type that code and your account email below:

budgetExhausted.message: This month’s capacity cannot cover this operation.

budgetExhaustedUntil.message: Capacity renews on {date}. Reading and organising remain available.

itemTooLarge.message: This item exceeds the processing limit.

budgetUnavailable.message: Processing is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

providerSuspended.message: This service is paused for now. Your library stays available; try again later.

networkError.message: Network error. Please check your connection and try again.

sourceRefused.message: This link isn't supported. Supported links: podcast episodes and shows (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, Deezer, RSS feeds), YouTube and TikTok videos, Instagram posts and reels, Facebook posts and videos, X posts, Reddit threads, web pages (articles, LinkedIn posts…), audio files.

folderDuplicate.message: A folder already has this name here. Choose another name.

fullTextFailed.message: Unable to load the text right now.

translationFailed.message: Translation failed. Showing the original text.

incompleteBody.message: The site reserves the rest of this article for its subscribers. Deepn could only read this beginning; the summary and the chat cover this part.

chatInterruptedCancelled.message: Stopped. The answer above is incomplete.

chatInterruptedOutputLimit.message: The answer reached its maximum length and stops here.

chatInterruptedError.message: An error interrupted the answer. What arrived is kept.

chatQuestionTooLong.message: This question is {length} characters long; the limit is {max}. Shorten it and try again. Your draft is preserved.

chatConversationFull.message: This conversation has reached {max} questions. Start a new one to keep going.

chatContextBudget.message: The question and conversation exceed the available context. Shorten your question or start a new conversation. Your draft is preserved.

chatTurnInFlight.message: An answer is still on its way. Wait for it before asking again.

chatTurnCountChanged.message: The conversation changed in the meantime. Try again.

chatRefusalGeneric.message: The question could not be sent. Try again.

generatingMeta.message: {type} · A few seconds · you can leave this screen

notebookLoadFailed.message: Unable to load generated content. Please try again.

artifactMediaEmpty.message: This item has no transcript yet, so there is nothing to generate from.

artifactTooMuchText.message: There is too much text here for one generation. Generate on a smaller subfolder instead.

artifactRefusalGeneric.message: Unable to start this generation. Please try again.

flashDoneSome.message: Go over the ones you missed now, while it’s fresh.

panelEmpty.message: Click the Deepn icon, or press Alt+S, to save the page you are reading: its essentials, its full text and its notebook will appear here.

chatEmpty.message: Ask a question: the answer draws on the text of this page.

notebookInApp.message: Customize, rename or delete an entry in Deepn

linkFailed.message: This link could not be saved.

chatWaiting.message: The chat opens once processing is done.
